nodes.title: Add a repo view beside the chat

Greptile Summary

The PR adds a persistent repository Changes view beside Chat, backed by Git history and working-tree reads. It also repairs unborn repositories by diffing them against Git’s empty tree. - Adds Chat/Changes view tabs while preserving mounted view state. - Adds uncommitted-file, commit-history, and split/unified diff panes. - Adds Git commands and frontend hooks for HEAD-tree and history reads. - Adds shared avatar resolution and reusable diff/file-list components.

Confidence Score: 4/5

The PR should not merge until failed HEAD lookups stop misclassifying valid repositories and hiding their changes. A valid repository can still be presented as a non-repository because both backend Git failures and frontend invocation failures collapse into the same `null` sentinel used by the repaired empty state. **Files Needing Attention:** apps/desktop/src/hooks/useRepo.ts, apps/desktop/src/components/changes/ChangesView.tsx, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/git.rs

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | apps/desktop/src/hooks/useRepo.ts | Adds repository polling hooks, but failed HEAD lookups are still converted into the non-repository sentinel. | | apps/desktop/src/components/changes/ChangesView.tsx | Adds the repository browser and correctly handles unborn repositories, while relying on `null` as a definitive non-repository result. | | apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/git.rs | Adds HEAD-tree, history, commit, push, and recency support, including the empty-tree baseline for unborn repositories. | | apps/desktop/src/App.tsx | Integrates per-session Chat and Changes tabs while preserving mounted state. | | apps/desktop/src/components/changes/DiffPane.tsx | Adds the full-height repository diff pane and split/unified presentation controls. |
Prompt To Fix All With AI `````markdown ### Issue 1 apps/desktop/src/hooks/useRepo.ts:80 **Failed lookups mimic non-repositories** When the `head_tree` invocation fails for a valid repository, this catch stores `null` and the lookup is marked settled, so `ChangesView` reports that the session is not in a Git repository and hides its uncommitted files without exposing the error or an in-view retry. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````
Reviews (2): Last reviewed commit: ["fix(changes): tell an unborn repo from a..."](https://github.com/monorepo-labs/dray/commit/b30aaf267437dbc6cee37081568d9c8cb7e1d82e) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=55844884)
**Devin Review** found 2 potential issues.

🟡 **Real repositories flash "not a git repository"** On first activation, `head.tree` is null until its async read resolves, and `working.changes` is still null, so the empty-state guard reads null-with-no-changes as a non-repo. A real repository briefly shows "This session is not in a git repository." before the first read lands.
Prompt for agents ``` The empty-state guard in ChangesView treats head.tree===null && !working.changes as "not a git repository", but head.tree is null during the initial async load of useHeadTree (which fires after first paint), so a genuine repo flashes the wrong message for a few frames until head_tree resolves. Distinguish "still loading" from "confirmed non-repo": for example, have useHeadTree expose whether its first read has completed (a loading/settled flag), and only show the non-repo message once that read has landed and returned null. Until then, render the normal loading UI (the sub-tab list already shows "Reading the working tree…"). ```
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **New `fill` prop on the diff viewer is never used** `DiffView` gained a `fill` prop documented for "a pane whose whole job is this diff", but `DiffPane`'s `Body` renders `DiffView` without it, so it defaults to false. The unhighlighted fallback caps at `max-h-96` in a full-height pane during highlighter load. Confirm whether the pane was meant to pass `fill`. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

**Unborn repositories look invalid** When a valid repository has no first commit, `head_tree` returns `null` and `useChanges` cannot populate `working.changes`, so this branch permanently reports that the session is not in a Git repository and hides its uncommitted files.
